summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a notice and proxy statement for a special shareholder meeting on August 26, 2026. The sole proposal seeks board authorization to effect a reverse share split at a ratio between 1-for-4 and 1-for-40, within 12 months, without amending the Articles, effectively increasing authorized capital proportionally. This is a routine corporate-governance matter, not a special-situation event. The board unanimously recommends approval; no acquisition, tender, restructuring, or similar transaction is involved. Watch for the board's determination of the exact ratio and effective date.
